scope: component nineteen weighted H22 fibres at q=0, phi=+1 and phi=-1 separately over Q(p), p!=0
method: separate direct endpoint plane reconstruction, exact permanents and pair minors, complete finite/infinity shared binary-orientation elimination, exact three-dimensional shared kernels, saturated one-marked rank stratification, and fixed transverse minors
limitations: Both endpoints were independently verified; the construction discovery label remains CANDIDATE.
Only q=0, phi=+1 or -1, p!=0 in the finite opposite-plane chart is covered.
Projective opposite-plane boundaries, p=0, component exhaustiveness, arbitrary-order reduction, the prize graph, and the global Krenn-Gu conjecture are not addressed.
